cells.behavior: Signed int16/int32/int64 with range checks; positive variants add database CHECK >=0. No silent overflow.
cells.family: SmallInteger, Integer, BigInteger; PositiveSmallInteger, PositiveInteger, PositiveBigInteger

cells.behavior: Generated integer identity, UUID value or ordered composite tuple. Exactly one primary-key descriptor. Composite references map every component, including Admin URLs.
Decimal value preserves base-10 precision/scale; float64 explicitly approximate; bool false distinguished from absent. PostgreSQL numeric/double precision/boolean.
String length/format validators; varchar/text/inet mappings; normalized URL/email policy explicit, no universal case-folding of email local parts.
cells.family: Char, Text, Slug, Email, URL, GenericIPAddress

cells.behavior: Enumerate paths only within configured root with regex/recursive/file-directory options; store relative path, never client-selected arbitrary server filesystem access.
Date/time distinct from instant; DateTime stored as UTC timestamptz; Duration exact microsecond interval. Timezone conversion at boundaries.
Byte slice uses bytea; JSON uses jsonb with validated size/depth and versioned shape optional. No executable or arbitrary object deserialization.
Opaque storage key and metadata; image validates actual decode, dimensions and type. No image processing service or cloud provider implied.
Explicit relation keys and on-delete behavior; one-to-one unique; many-to-many join model; generic reference uses content-type registry and lacks a normal DB FK.
cells.family: ForeignKey, OneToOne, ManyToMany; through; generic reference

cells.behavior: Database-generated expression is read-only with persisted/virtual capability checked. Custom type implements schema, encode/decode, validation, form and serializer mapping.
PG array element codec, hstore extension, numeric/date/timestamp range bounds, full-text and PostGIS-specific types; unsupported extensions rejected explicitly.
null controls DB; blank controls form validation; default runs once per new instance; db_default evaluated by DB; server-owned/read-only fields cannot be mass assigned.
cells.family: null, blank, default, db_default, editable, serialize

cells.behavior: Enumerated values share labels with forms; relative-date uniqueness checked by policy/transaction and explicit supporting constraint when expressible, not guaranteed by preflight alone.
Explicit identifiers safely quoted; index strategy/collation and tablespace must be allowed backend capabilities.
Metadata flags describe ownership and generated value behavior; noneditable fields excluded from user input by default.
Localized labels shared across Admin/forms/API metadata; escaping remains output-engine responsibility.
cells.family: verbose_name, help_text, display labels, ordering choices

cells.behavior: Resolve at frozen registry; scoped choices enforced again on mutation; disabling FK constraint is explicit and cannot claim referential safety.
cells.family: related_name/query_name, to_field, through_fields, limit_choices_to, db_constraint, swappable

cells.behavior: Model metadata drives migrations and default query ordering; order_with_respect_to uses an explicit order column with stable sibling ordering.
cells.family: db_table/comment/tablespace, app_label, managed, abstract, proxy, ordering, get_latest_by, order_with_respect_to

cells.behavior: Manager selection explicit; managers do not grant authorization. Required features checked during registration and migrations.
Descriptor captures name and all options; generated schema and DB enforcement agree. Deprecated shorthand unique_together/index_together maps to explicit constraints/indexes on import.
cells.family: Index, UniqueConstraint, CheckConstraint; expressions, conditions, include, opclasses, deferrable, nulls_distinct

cells.behavior: FullClean/CleanFields/Clean/ValidateUnique/ValidateConstraints are explicit; ordinary Save does not invoke them. Save follows PK/state/force-option INSERT/UPDATE rules. Refresh clears relation caches; deferred fields use explicit Go accessors.
cells.family: PK, State, Validate/Clean, Save, Delete, Refresh, FromDB, PrepareDatabaseSave, field display, next/previous/date navigation
